moderation_email_edit_reverted_subject: An administrator reverted a change to {entryName}
moderation_email_edit_reverted_preheader: See what was reverted and why.
moderation_email_edit_reverted_body_1: an administrator of {siteName} reverted one of the changes made to your listing {entryName}.
moderation_email_edit_reverted_body_2: The rest of the listing was not changed. If you think this is a mistake, reply to this message or enter the change again.
moderation_email_approved_preheader_new: It is public. Set a password to edit it.
moderation_email_approved_preheader_exis: It is public. Log in to edit it.
moderation_email_approved_body_1: good news: the listing {entryName} passed review and is now public on {siteName}.
moderation_email_approved_body_new: We created an account for you. Set a password so you can edit the listing, post opportunities and connect with other listings. The link works for {expiry}.
moderation_email_approved_body_existing: You already have an account with this address, so log in with it to edit the listing, post opportunities and connect with other listings.
moderation_email_approved_body_2: After this first approval your changes go live at once.
moderation_email_rejected_preheader: The application for {entryName} was not approved. You can fix it and send it again.
moderation_email_rejected_body_1: we reviewed the application for the listing {entryName} on {siteName}. We cannot publish it for now.
moderation_email_rejected_reason_duplica: The same or a very similar listing already exists on {siteName}. If it is yours, claim it instead of sending a new one: {claimHint}.
moderation_email_rejected_reason_out_of_: This listing is outside what {siteName} covers. The scope is described on the About page: {aboutLink}.
moderation_email_rejected_reason_incompl: The application lacks information needed to publish it, for example a description, a contact or a place. Add it and send again.
moderation_email_rejected_reason_unverif: We could not verify the details in the application. Add a website or another public source that confirms the organization or your link to it, then send again.
moderation_email_rejected_body_2: You can edit the application and send it again. We keep it for 90 days, then it is deleted.
moderation_email_application_digest_preh: {count} applications await a decision. The oldest is {oldestAge} days old.
moderation_email_application_digest_body: since the last summary, {count} applications arrived. In total {openTotal} are waiting for review. Applications older than {days} days are marked in the queue. Each line shows name, kind, country and age.
moderation_email_report_digest_body: since the last summary, visitors reported {count} listings. None was hidden automatically. They wait for your decision. Each line shows the listing and the reason the visitor gave.
moderation_email_application_received_bo: thank you. We received your application for the listing {entryName} on {siteName}. Administrators review it within 7 days. We will send you the decision at this address.
Until then, the listing is not public. If you want to correct something, reply to this message.
moderation_email_approved_body_existing_: You already have an account with this address, but it has no password yet. Set one to edit the listing, post opportunities and connect with other listings. The link works for {expiry}.
